scope: Six preselected public teacher-support phases only; trace observes root fit locals and replays retained trees against those current teachers. U, held-out queries, HDS, scoring, and raw-grid serialization are excluded.
decision: REJECT ANYTIME-RETAINED-ROOT HYPOTHESIS FOR THIS SIX-PHASE SAMPLE: every root fit raised at the fit-state cap with zero completed root candidates retained. There is no complete candidate to publish as an anytime proposal in these cases. The synthetic passivity control observed one returned root candidate, replayed all 18 teacher cells exactly, and matched traced/untraced status, counters, and forest.
limitation: Does not prove that no other grammar, support set, or phase can retain a complete root candidate; trace elapsed times are not comparable.
next_action: Do not implement anytime candidate publication or widen caps from this hypothesis. Redirect public-data diagnosis to candidate-generation coverage while preserving the current grammar/support gates; continue tracking official submission 57682971.
repository_line_ending_policy: Evidence text files are committed with LF; original CRLF worktree hashes are retained in execution_worktree_sha256 fields.
post_run_portability_change: The trace script was updated after the completed run to hash text inputs in repository LF form. Search, fit, and trace logic were unchanged.
